title: Niri Compositor Schema
description: Validation schema for the Niri Wayland compositor configuration

Input.description: Input device configuration (keyboard, mouse, touchpad, trackpoint).

Keyboard.description: Keyboard settings, including XKB configuration and numlock.

XKB.description: XKB settings (rules, model, layout, variant, and options).

disabled-on-external-mouse.description: Disable touchpad when an external mouse is connected.

scroll-button.description: Button ID to use for scrolling.

warp-mouse-to-focus.description: Warp the mouse to the center of newly focused windows.

focus-follows-mouse.description: Focus windows and outputs automatically when moving the mouse into them.

max-scroll-amount.description: Scroll threshold for focus follows mouse (e.g., '0%').

Outputs.description: Output (monitor) configurations mapped by output name (e.g., 'eDP-1').

transform.description: Rotation or reflection of the output.

position.description: Position of the output in global coordinate space.

Layout.description: Settings influencing how windows are positioned and sized.

gaps.description: Gaps around windows in logical pixels.

center-focused-column.description: Behavior for centering columns when changing focus.

proportions.description: Widths as fractions of output width.
Heights as fractions of output height.

FocusRing.description: Settings for the focus ring around active windows.

Border.description: Settings for the permanent window border.

draw-behind-window.description: Draw shadow behind window (fixes CSD corner artifacts).

Struts.description: Shrinks the area occupied by windows, like outer gaps.

spawn-at-startup.description: Commands to spawn directly without shell.

prefer-no-csd.description: Ask clients to omit client-side decorations.

screenshot-path.description: Path to save screenshots. Null disables saving to disk.

skip-at-startup.description: Skip showing the overlay at startup.

hide-not-bound.description: Hide unbound hotkeys in the overlay.

disable-failed.description: Disable notifications for failed config updates.

slowdown.description: Factor to slow down all animations.

WindowRules.description: Rules modifying behavior for individual windows.

open-on-output.description: Make the window open on a specific output.

open-on-workspace.description: Make the window open on a specific named workspace.

open-maximized.description: Make the window open as a maximized column.

open-maximized-to-edges.description: Make the window open maximized to edges.

open-floating.description: Make the window open in the floating layout.

open-focused.description: Allow or prevent the window from being automatically focused.

opacity.description: Set the opacity of the window (0.0 to 1.0).

variable-refresh-rate.description: Enable VRR on output when this window is displayed.

default-column-display.description: Set the default display mode for columns created from this window.

default-floating-position.description: Set the initial position for this window when it opens in the floating layout.

scroll-factor.description: Set a scroll factor for all scroll events sent to a window.

draw-border-with-background.description: Override whether the border and the focus ring draw with a background.

focus-ring.description: Override the focus ring options for the window.

border.description: Override the border options for the window.

shadow.description: Override the shadow options for the window.

tab-indicator.description: Override the tab indicator options for the window.

oneOf.description: CSS-style corner radii: [top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left]

geometry-corner-radius.description: Set the corner radius of the window.

clip-to-geometry.description: Clips the window to its visual geometry.

tiled-state.description: Informs the window that it is tiled.

baba-is-float.description: Make your windows FLOAT up and down (April Fools 2025).

popups.description: Override properties for this window's pop-ups.

cooldown-ms.description: Rate-limit the bind (useful for scroll wheels).

repeat.description: Allow or disallow holding to repeat.

allow-when-locked.description: Execute even if screen is locked.

allow-inhibiting.description: Whether software can inhibit this keybind.

hotkey-overlay-title.description: Title shown in the hotkey overlay.

move-column-to-workspace.description: Move column to workspace by index.

move-window-to-workspace.description: Move window to workspace by index.

relative-to.description: Render relative to entire view rather than window.

widthHeightDefinition.description: Sets sizing either by proportion or fixed pixels. An empty object unsets the default.

windowMatchObject.description: Individual match conditions for a window rule.

oneOf.description: List of match rules (OR logic across objects, AND logic within objects).

backgroundEffectDef.description: Background effects like blur and noise.

xray.description: Enable the efficient xray blur effect.

blur.description: Enable standard blur behind the surface.

noise.description: Amount of pixel noise added to the background.

saturation.description: Color saturation of the background (1 is normal).
